mutations.name: type-guard
mutations.what: a method or a route that is not a string reaches the comparison
mutations.equivalent: a value that is not a string equals no method and no route of the lists, so the answer is false either way; the guard only says so first

patches.old: if (typeof method !== 'string' || typeof route !== 'string') return false;

mutations.name: provider-code

patches.old: return { code: ERROR_CODES.AUTH_REQUIRED, message: `DatGold has no model connected.
patches.new: return { code: ERROR_CODES.INTERNAL, message: `DatGold has no model connected.
